response.sql: WITH pairs AS (SELECT s.transref, t.tradekind, AVG(s.anlycount) AS pair_avg FROM sentimentandfundamentals s JOIN transactionrecord tr ON tr.transreg = s.transref JOIN trader t ON t.tradereg = s.trdref2 WHERE t.tradekind IS NOT NULL GROUP BY s.transref, t.tradekind), overall AS (SELECT AVG(pair_avg) AS overall_mean FROM pairs), kept AS (SELECT p.tradekind, p.pair_avg, p.pair_avg - o.overall_mean AS margin FROM pairs p CROSS JOIN overall o WHERE p.pair_avg > o.overall_mean), per_type AS (SELECT tradekind, AVG(pair_avg) AS avg_analyst_count, AVG(margin) AS avg_margin FROM kept GROUP BY tradekind) SELECT tradekind, avg_analyst_count, avg_margin, avg_analyst_count / AVG(avg_analyst_count) OVER () AS relative_to_mean FROM per_type ORDER BY tradekind

assumptions.assumption: The snapshot's trader type comes from the snapshot's own trader reference (trdref2 joined to trader.tradereg). Snapshots with a NULL trdref2 are skipped, as are those with no matching trader.
Snapshots 'matching their transaction' means an inner join of transref to transactionrecord.transreg.
Pairs whose anlycount values are all NULL have a NULL average. They are excluded from the overall mean and from the kept pairs.
The overall mean is the unweighted mean of the pair averages. The final ratio divides each type's average by the unweighted mean of the per-type averages, taken over the types that have kept pairs.

alternatives.interpretation: The trader type is taken from the transaction's trader (transactionrecord.trdref) instead of the snapshot's trdref2.
